title: Anagram groups
statement:
Two words are anagrams when one is a rearrangement of the letters of the other ("listen" and "silent"). Group the given words so that each group holds all the words that are anagrams of one another.

Input: the first line holds n. The second line holds n distinct words separated by single spaces. Every word uses lowercase letters a-z only.
Output: one line per group. On each line print the words of the group in alphabetical order, separated by single spaces. Print the groups with the most words first; groups of equal size are ordered by their first (alphabetically smallest) word.

Constraints: 1 <= n <= 10000, every word has 1 to 20 letters.

Example:
Input:
6
eat tea tan ate nat bat
Output:
ate eat tea
nat tan
bat
